title: Philipp Leibfried in CDR on funding in the Netherlands
summary: Burford Head of Europe Philipp Leibfried spoke to CDR about the growing interest in funding in the Netherlands. Learn more.
body_markdown:
Burford Head of Europe[Philipp Leibfried](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/philipp-leibfried/) spoke to CDR about the growing interest in funding in the Netherlands.


Leibfried says: "The Netherlands is a significant growth market for legal finance, not only in respect of opt-out class action claims under WAMCA, but also opt-in matters where claims are assigned to a claimant entity, commercial litigation and arbitration, securities litigation, and restructuring and insolvency matters."


[Click here to read the full article.](https://www.cdr-news.com/categories/third-party-funding/21716-how-much-for-the-dutch)
